column2: an open ledger book lying flat, seen from above at a slight angle, two thick pages with a few bold horizontal line cuts for writing, and a long quill pen standing upright in an inkwell beside it on the right
a heavy arched wooden door seen straight from the front, three horizontal iron bands with rivets across it and a large round ring knocker in the middle
a single square castle tower with battlements (three crenels on top), a tall arched doorway cut out at its base and one narrow arrow-slit window above it
a heavy chain of office: a loop of large thick oval links hanging in a U shape from the top corners, with one large square medallion hanging at the bottom centre

the Hand of the King's badge: a brooch made of a single stylised hand, fingers together pointing straight down, thumb tucked against the side, set inside an oval ring frame that joins the wrist; a short horizontal pin bar across the top of the frame. It must read as a jewelled badge of office, not a glove
a fat coin purse tied at the neck with a cord, its top gathered into a frill, two round coins in front of it at the bottom
a large old keyhole shape (round top, flaring tapered bottom) cut out of a solid square door plate with four round rivet holes in its corners
the head of a hound in profile facing left, ears drooping, long muzzle, a studded collar at the neck; one eye cut-out, one slit for the collar
a round wax seal with a thick irregular blob edge, and in its centre a stag's head with a crown between its antlers cut out as white negative space
an hourglass: two glass bulbs between a flat top plate and a flat bottom plate, with two side posts; the sand shown as solid black in the bottom bulb and a thin cut between the bulbs
a tall wine goblet (a chalice) with a wide bowl, a knotted stem and a broad foot; a single drop falling from the rim on one side
a straight longsword snapped in two: the hilt and a short broken stub of blade upright on the left, the broken-off blade piece tilted beside it on the right, a jagged break between them
a round wedding pie seen from the side, its crust burst open at the top with a dove flying out of it, wings raised
a curved war horn (a hunting horn) lying horizontally, wide bell to the right, narrow mouthpiece to the left, two metal bands around it and a carrying strap hanging below in a loop
an armoured gauntlet (a plate-metal glove) lying flat as if thrown down, fingers spread, cuff at the bottom, seen from the back of the hand, with cut lines between the plates
a long swallow-tailed pennant (a knight's banner) flying to the right from a short upright lance
a single narrowed eye, almond-shaped, heavy lowered lid, a round pupil cut out; no face around it
a wide wine goblet standing upright with a bunch of grapes leaning against its foot on the right
a straight longsword standing upright, point down, with a broad blade, a straight crossguard and a round pommel; one cut down the blade's centre
the head of a stag seen straight from the front, with large symmetric branching antlers, two ear points, a narrow muzzle; two eye cut-outs
two hands clasped in a forearm grip, seen from the side, horizontal, each with a plain cuff

a tall throne made of many swords fused together, seen straight from the front: a fan of upright sword blades rising behind a seat, a few blades pointing out at the sides, short steps at the base; symmetric
a round coin seen face-on with a thick rim, a three-headed dragon cut out in its centre as negative space
a heavy war hammer standing upright, head at the top: a big rectangular hammer block with a short spike on one side, a long thick haft with a grip band
a simple king's crown seen straight from the front: a broad band with five tall pointed spikes, a round cut-out gem in the band below each of the three middle spikes
a tall wine flagon (an ewer) with a curved spout and a looped handle, standing upright, a lid on top
a straight wooden ladder standing upright with five rungs, slightly narrower at the top
a large old iron key standing upright, a round bow at the top with a cut-out ring, a long shaft and a blocky bit at the bottom
a rolled parchment scroll lying horizontally, tied in the middle with a ribbon whose two ends hang down, a round wax seal on the ribbon
an empty hooded cloak seen from the front: a deep pointed hood whose opening is one large dark void cut out as white, the cloak falling to the shoulders, nobody inside
a slim dagger standing upright point down, a long narrow blade with a ridge, a short straight crossguard, a wrapped grip and a round pommel
a plain heater shield (flat top, sides curving to a point at the bottom) with one diagonal band cut across it
a wine goblet knocked over on its side, the bowl to the right, a pool of spilled wine flowing out of its rim
